abstract: As AI becomes increasingly embedded in multiplayer online games, AI-controlled players are frequently deployed as opponents to human players. Whereas this practice is becoming increasingly common, its impact on player engagement, social interactions, and the broader game ecosystem remains unclear. Our study investigates the effects of introducing AI players using a natural experiment from a popular multiplayer online game. We find that AI players significantly increase player engagement and encourage players to team up with friends more frequently. These effects are driven by enhanced self-efficacy and perceived team responsibility. Moreover, the positive effects are particularly strong among novice players and among players who previously preferred teaming up with strangers. Our findings offer valuable insights for game developers seeking to enhance player engagement and foster social interaction, highlighting the potential of carefully designed AI participants to strengthen online communities and improve player retention.

ob.tldr: 研究多人在线游戏中引入AI玩家对玩家参与度及社交互动的影响。通过一款流行MMO游戏的自然实验发现，AI玩家显著提升玩家参与度，并促使玩家更频繁与朋友组队，机制在于自我效能感和团队责任感的增强。该效应在新手玩家和此前偏好与陌生人组队的玩家中尤为明显，表明精心设计的AI参与者可增强在线社区。

title: Interlopers or Catalysts? Dissecting the Impact of Incorporating AI Players on Multiplayer Online Games
title_zh: 入侵者还是催化剂？：剖析AI玩家对多人在线游戏的影响
